source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-16

procedures.title: Four-speed transmissions (Muncie and Saginaw): general description
notes: Muncie shifting: rods go to the cover shifter levers for first through fourth and to the reverse lever in the case extension. The rear cover lever works 1st/2nd, the front lever 3rd/4th. All forward gears synchronized; reverse is an unsynchronized helical gear.

Saginaw 4-speed: similar to the Saginaw 3-speed (ball bearings, single-row countergear rollers, anti-rattle plate). Its reverse idler is always meshed with the 1-2 synchronizer gear and turns on an in-place bored bushing on a short shaft retained by a Woodruff key.

Saginaw 4-speed differences from the 3-speed: front synchronizer does 3rd/4th, rear does 1st/2nd; the 1-2 sleeve carries reverse gear teeth; mainshaft gears from the front are third, second, first; a fourth blocker ring sits between the 1-2 synchronizer and first gear.
Saginaw 4-speed side cover is on the left of the case, like the 3-speed cover plus a reverse shifter shaft, detent ball and detent spring.

procedures.title: Four-speed shift linkage adjustment
parts: transmission shift levers L, M, N
steps: Loosen the swivel locknuts on the shift rods so the rods slide freely in the swivels.
Put transmission levers L, M and N in their neutral detents.
Move control lever A to its neutral detent and insert locating gauge B in the control lever bracket.
Tighten the swivel locknuts on the reverse rod.
Do the same for the 1st/2nd rod (D) and the 3rd/4th rod.
Remove the gauge and throw it away.
Check that it shifts properly and readjust if needed.
notes: Corvette linkage is shown in figure 18 in the manual; figure 17 covers other car lines.
After removing the gauge on Camaro with Muncie only, shorten the rod three turns with the jam nuts (not a Corvette step).
The manual labels both the reverse lever and the 3rd/4th rod as "E".

procedures.title: Gearshift lever reverse blocker cable: replace and adjust
steps: Replacement: remove the console (seat separator).
Remove the lever seal retainer and slide the seal up the lever.
Remove the knob and the 2 bolts holding the lever to the bracket; take out the lever.
Feed the new blocker cable up through the lever and T-handle and fit the cable retainer through the access slot.
Set the retainer so the blocker end sits .010/.020" above the lever bracket face, then lock it and cut off the extra cable.
Reinstall by reversing the first three steps.
Adjustment: with the set screw loose, pass the cable through the hole in the round retainer above the handle.
With the handle fully down, pull the cable taut and set it to the dimension shown in figure 19 in the manual.
Tighten the set screw.
Bend over and cut the extra wire so it does not foul the lever bore or the knob threads.

specs.what: blocker end above lever bracket surface

notes: The handle must spring back freely from any position.
Figure 19 in the manual shows adjustment and lubrication points.

procedures.title: Four-speed shift control lever and bracket assembly
parts: shift control lever and bracket assembly
steps: Use the three-speed control lever and bracket replacement procedure (Corvette version on page 7-7).

procedures.title: Speedometer driven gear and oil seal: replace (four-speed)
steps: Disconnect the speedometer cable.
Remove the retainer bolt and lock washer, then the retainer.
Pry the fitting, gear and shaft out of the housing with a screwdriver in the fitting slot.
Pry the O-ring out of its groove, fit a new one and insert the shaft.
With the fitting slot toward the housing boss, push the assembly into the housing until the retainer can enter the groove.
Install the retainer, lock washer and bolt.
